sloka: तथा ब्रुवाणम् सौमित्रिम् प्रदीप्तम् इव तेजसा ।अब्रवीत् लक्ष्मणम् तारा तारा अधिप निभ आनना ॥४-३५-१॥
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇam saumitrim pradīptam iva tejasā ।abravīt lakṣmaṇam tārā tārā adhipa nibha ānanā ॥4-35-1॥

translations.english: While Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, was glowing like fire with his brilliance, thus spoke the moonfaced Tara:
